svg.title: Fintra — User Journey
svg.desc: Journey from homepage discovery to habitual monthly use: discover, try, sign in, first value, trust deepening, habit — with touchpoints, KPIs and friction watchlist.
svg.text: From first touch to monthly habit — stages, emotions, Fintra touchpoints and the friction we watch. See 00-product-vision/user-journeys.md.
Design priority: eliminate friction at Sign-in and Trust stages first — see 02-ui-ux/ux-flows.md (F1, F9).
